notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone, after many setbacks (both technical and personal), the new update is just around the corner, with its release hopefully this month!

There are quite a few changes, here's a list of most of them:

- New level
- Main menu redesign
- Improvement in performance
- New graphic and performance settings in the pause menu
- Small improvements to AI
- New enemies
- New weapon
- Removed static from in-game sections

There are few more changes here and there but these are the main, unfortunately there are some changes that won't make it to the upcoming update due to technical issues but they will be in the following update. Among these changes are:

- Saving system.
- Key binding

Now, here are a few pictures!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE THIS MONTH
notes.content:
Hello there! Well, as you may already know, It's been a little over a month since my last update which was mostly bug fixes and addition of new features to the already existing content.

Well, I'm proud to say that I've been working on the next update which will hopefully arrive this month. It will feature a new level: Footage #2! This new level is a follow up from the previous level, however, new content will appear as well as new features... among few other things :-) It will also include fixes and polishing of already existing stuff.

I won't share too many details just yet, that's something I will first discuss with my kickstarter backers, which are the reason this game is here in the first place (I hope you did open the credits, the top right button on the main menu, dew it!), once I get their feedback I will give you details regarding the campaign and the upcoming update.

Oh, and I'm also laying out on paper every single detail of the actual campaign for the Final release of the game, scenes layout, script, events, etc, once every detail of it is ready I will work on parallel with the footage on the campaign and give you details of it (of course, once I talk to my backers first)

If there's anything else you wanna know about this game please let me know by leaving a comment here or opening a thread, I sometimes take long to reply because of lack of time but I do read them, so don't be shy and post your opinions and suggestions on what is already in-game.

Well guys, that's it for now, this update is mostly to not keep you in the shadows, I don't want you to think I'm not working on this, I'm here and I'm watching you from above like the ceiling cat.

Have a great day everyone! Expect the update anytime soon this month!

notes.title: Update #1 just released - Changelog
notes.content:
Hey guys, I just released the first update a few minutes ago, here's the list of changes:

- Added settings to the pause menu, now you can change volume, change quality and toggle the static and noise if you find it distracting

- Fixed lag when you approach the tunnel

- Fixed the level's ending

- Added the settings to the main menu

- Added the credits section mentioning the kickstarter backers

- Kinda fixed sounds from enemies, some of them work now but I just realized some files are corrupted so I still have to fix some audio files

More content is on its way, I will add more features to the settings are well as to the existing content, not to mention I'm gonna add a new level.

So yeah, that's it for now, I hope you like those small changes, expect more updates.

NOTE: The updates will be kinda slow, I have a full time job (I need the money) so it's really difficult to find free time to work on updates... but I'm still here and I will be until this game goes from early access to full release! Stay tuned guys!
